INSERT INTO opportunities (title, org, type, deadline, link, requirements, status, added_on, dedup_key)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NULLIF($4,'')::date, $5, $6, $7, CURRENT_DATE, $8)
     ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
     RETURNING *;
